tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ zhi khro bsam gtan cho ga la brten pa'i sbyin sreg ye shes me 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so/ ngag la ngag gi dbang thob 'jam pa'i dpal// mkhas btsun bzang po'i dge ba'i bshes su snang*// mig mi 'dzum pa karma chags med dang*// gnyis med rdo rje 'dzin la gus btud nas// zab lam ngo mtshar phul phyin pa'i// gnam chos thugs gter zhi khro yi// sbyin sreg blo dman 'jug bde ba'i/ khrigs chags bri la gnang ba stsol/ gang du bya ba'i gnas su gzhi bdag la gtor ma dang gser skyems sogs 'du byas la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: bh+rum̐ las rin chen snod nang du: gtor ma 'dod yon phung po gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra a ka ro= sogs sbyar ba lan gsum/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 586)'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gser skyems rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud dang*/ sku gsum brgyud gsum ma gtang*/ rdo rje dang bcas lag g.yas sar bzhag cing*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum dang*/ rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs la stong nyid kyis rgyas btab/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ gis ba byung dang dri bzang gis chag chag gdab pa'i gzhir/ tshangs zur thig gdab rgyar khru gang*// mchu dang kha khyer sor bzhi re// nang du cha phran rdor phreng gis// bskor nang 'dab brgyad rdo rjes mtshan// grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras/ kha dog kun nas dkar po'i steng*// bud shing ji ltar rigs pa rtsigs// mchod rdzas sreg rdzas 'du byas la// bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang*// bsdu ldang bcas pa grub par bya/ de nas cho ga dngos la/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ dril bu dkrol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a

587) nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃḥ 'khyud rgya bcas bya/ mchod pa las byang ltar byin gyis brlabs/ sreg rdzas la bdud rtsis bran la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg cing*/ oṃ swa hā/ rdzas rnams bkru/ yam shing la/ oṃ āḥswa hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shrīṃ swa hā/ 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dz+riṃ swa hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swa hā/ stong pa'i ngang las sreg rdzas rnams// ming yig thig les brgyan pa las// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin ni// sreg rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ ag+ne ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra puṇ+ṭa ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā 588) ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra gasma ri swa hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swa hā/ lan gsum / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swa hā/ lan gsum gyis brlabs/ oṃ ag+ne dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas me sbar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ oṃ ag+ne swa hā/ mar khu blugs/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes bzlas pa'i ku sha/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas g.yas bskor du bkram/ thab la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las// zhi ba'i thab khung 589) zlum zhing dkar// mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus// pad zlar raṃ las me yi lha// dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// g.yas gnyis dbyug pa bgrang phreng dang*// g.yon gnyis ril ba skyabs sbyin mdzad// drang srong chas can du mas bskor// gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ yig gi

/'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs gyur/ oṃ/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ ag+na ye a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ oṃ a g+ne de wa sa pā ri wa ra pad+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ oṃ ag+na ye 590) a ma ya s+t+waṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med gyur// me lha cung zad 'dzum pa yi// ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi khar// yi ge raṃ gyis mtshan pa las// sreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i dwangs mar drangs// gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par gyur/ dgang blugs 'bul bzhin du/ oṃ ag+na ye swa hā/ lan bdun/ oṃ ag+na ye dī bya dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor 'das kyi// sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun phyogs// thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa de 'dra lan gsum/ oṃ ag+ne sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ oṃ/ gzi brjid ldan pa me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad gsal mdzad pa// bdag gzhan don sgrub sa la bzhugs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la bstod/ de nas 591) rdzas 'bul ba la/ yam shing*/ oṃ bhodhi brik+ṣa ya swa hā/ bdun/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hā/ mar khu/ oṃ ag+na ye swa hā/ bdun/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la= til / oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swa hā/ bdun/ sdig pa thams cad= zho zan/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swa hā/ bdun/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la= 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swa hā/ bdun/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la= so ba/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swa hā/ bdun/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa= nas/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swa hā/

bdun/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la= sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swa hā/ bdun/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la= gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swa hā/ bdun/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la= 592) durba/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swa hā/ bdun/ tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa la= ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swa hā/ bdun/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hā/ zhes 'bul/ de nas yungs dkar thab tu gtor te/ oṃ ag+ne dī bya dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ drang srong chen pos srog rdzas rnams/ lha yi zhal du bstabs pa dang*// me nyid ye shes mer bsgyur nas// sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus// skye med chos dbyings zhing khams na/ sogs nas mdun bskyed gsal btab ste/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod bcas grub nas/ lha tshogs cung zad 'dzum pa yi// ljags dang gzar 593)bu gnyis kyi khar// yi ge raṃ gyis mtshan pa las// sreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i dwangs mar drangs// gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par gyur/ dgang blugs/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig 'bul ba de 'dra lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ lan gcig gis sna drangs pa'i/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swa hā/ lan bcu/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la= lan gcig sbyar bas yam shing 'bul ba nas/ ku sha 'bul ba'i bar gong ltar/ de 'dra lan bcus sbyin sreg stong phrag tsam grub nas/ yig brgya lan gcig gis yungs dkar thab tu dor zhing*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor 'das kyi// sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun phyogs// thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ byon skyems/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ bdun/ yig brgyas phul ba de 'dra lan gsum/ las byang gi sman raka 'bul ba'i tshigs

594) bcad dang sngags kyis sreg gtor 'bul/ bum bskyed ltar mchod bstod dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ mar khus me gso zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ slar yang me lha skad cig gis// cha byad rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ byon skyems/ oṃ ag+na ye swa hā/ lan bdun/ oṃ ag+na ye dī bya dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor 'das kyi// sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun phyogs// thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'bul ba de 'dra lan gsum/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swa hā/ lan gsum/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa= lan gcig gis yam shing nas/ ku sha'i bar du lan bdun re 'bul/ me lha'i gtor ma/ oṃ ag+na ye a kā ro= btags pas phul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i 595)lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor 'das la// nad med tshe dang= sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las gsol/ yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis sgrub kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar byon nas// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs/ oṃ ag+na ye gats+tshaḥ zhes rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ las byang ltar bsngo smon dang bkra shis brjod/ 'dis ro sreg byed na/ me sbar mgor gnas lung gi me sbar btang nas/ bdag cag= sogs la/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa= sogs bsgyur bas 'grub cing*/ gzhan gsang ba spyi'i cho ga'i lugs ltar ro/ sbyin sreg 596) 'di mkhan chen sman chog mi 'khrugs/ rnam rgyal/ gnas chog kun rig 'ja' tshon zhi khro nges don rnying po/ thugs chen ngan song rang grol/ ltung bshags sogs la sbyar kyang lha sngags bsgyur bas 'grub bo/

rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dang*// 'pho med bde chen mnyam sbyor bas// mi 'gyur lhan skyes rdo rje'i bdag /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon byed shog ces pa'ang rang slob bde chen rgya mtshos bskul ngor dpal chen 'dus pas bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o//
